external_entities.name: Suppliers
external_entities.description: Suppliers who upload compliance paperwork and sign in to the portal.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal

external_entities.name: Category managers
external_entities.description: Category managers who review uploaded paperwork and approve or reject it.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.

external_entities.name: Vendor
external_entities.description: The SaaS vendor that hosts the portal and pushes nightly supplier data extracts.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The portal is a SaaS product. The vendor hosts it

processes.name: Supplier document portal
processes.description: A vendor-hosted SaaS portal through which suppliers upload compliance paperwork and category managers review and approve or reject it.

processes.name: Supplier master service
processes.description: A service that loads the nightly supplier data extract and writes the records into the supplier database.
processes.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_stores.name: Vendor's platform
data_stores.description: The vendor-hosted platform where supplier compliance documents remain.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.

data_stores.name: Landing bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket in the organization's cloud account that receives the nightly supplier data extract.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.

data_stores.name: Supplier database
data_stores.description: The database into which the supplier master service writes records from the extract.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_flows.name: Upload compliance paperwork
data_flows.description: Suppliers upload insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for their own staff to the portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal — insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for their own staff.
data_flows.data_description: Insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for suppliers' staff

data_flows.name: Review and decide on paperwork
data_flows.description: Category managers review uploaded paperwork and approve or reject it through the portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.
data_flows.data_description: Uploaded compliance paperwork and approval or rejection decisions

data_flows.name: Store documents
data_flows.description: The portal stores supplier compliance documents in the vendor's platform.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.

data_flows.name: Push supplier data extract
data_flows.description: The vendor pushes a nightly supplier data extract to the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_flows.notes: The source says both that the nightly extract is 'encrypted end to end' and that 'the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is.' These claims do not establish a single encryption value, so encryption in transit is unknown.

data_flows.name: Load supplier data extract
data_flows.description: The supplier master service picks up the nightly extract from the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The runbook for the landing bucket says the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is.
data_flows.notes: The source says both that the nightly extract is 'encrypted end to end' and that 'the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is.' These claims do not establish a single encryption value, so encryption in transit is unknown.

data_flows.name: Write supplier records
data_flows.description: The supplier master service writes records from the extract into the supplier database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.
data_flows.data_description: Supplier records from the nightly extract

trust_boundaries.name: Suppliers
trust_boundaries.description: The suppliers' external environment and control domain.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal

trust_boundaries.name: Vendor hosting
trust_boundaries.description: The vendor-controlled hosting environment for the SaaS portal and platform.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

trust_boundaries.name: Corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network from which category managers work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network

trust_boundaries.name: Cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The organization's cloud account containing the landing bucket, supplier master service, and supplier database.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The bucket, the service and the database are all in our cloud account.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier document portal presents a web interface.
assumptions.basis: The source names it as a portal, which is a web application interface under the extraction rules.

assumptions.assumption: The contents of the vendor's platform are confidential.
assumptions.basis: The platform holds compliance documents and contact details for suppliers' staff, which are personal and commercially sensitive records.

assumptions.assumption: The contents of the landing bucket are confidential.
assumptions.basis: The landing bucket holds a supplier data extract containing supplier records and contact details for staff.

assumptions.assumption: The contents of the supplier database are confidential.
assumptions.basis: The supplier database holds supplier records from the extract, including contact details for suppliers' staff.
